bloques.titulo: The technique of the arguative concession
texto: In the academic, legal and arbitration discourse, a solid argument begins by partially recognizing the validity of the objections of the counterparty and then making the thesis of its own prevail. The structure of this balance sheet is based on concessional and adverse connectors such as **zwar … aber / dennoch / trotzdem**: **Zwar ist das Vorhaben kostenintensiv, dennoch überwiegen die langfristigen Vorteile** (although the project is expensive, however, long-term advantages predominate).

bloques.titulo: Positional rules for dennoch and Trotzdem
texto: After a sentence introduced by **zwar**, the **dennoch** connector usually acts as a connective warning in the first position of the main clause, causing the immediate reversal of the finite verb (**V2**): **dennoch bietet die Maßnahme entscheidende Garantien**.

filas: Zwar gab es Verzögerungen, dennoch steht das Ergebnis.
Einerseits spart man Zeit, andererseits steigen Ausgaben.
Man muss einräumen, dass Risiken bestehen.

intro: We learn to articulate balanced rhetorical concessions and to make weighted opinions using connectors such as «zwar … dennoch» and «einerseits … andererseits».
